components.description: The lilac primary action, currently used for owner sign-in.
components.css: .ds-button { font: inherit; min-block-size: 2.75rem; padding-block: .65rem; padding-inline: 1rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 26%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius, .375rem); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button:active { background: var(--selection); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-button:hover { background: var(--selection); } } .ds-primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--background); font-weight: 600; border-color: transparent; } .ds-primary:active { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent), var(--foreground) 20%); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent), var(--foreground) 12%); } }

narrative.overview: A quiet, dark-only workspace where authored titles lead and interface furniture stays secondary. Aubergine and plum create distinct working regions; lilac selection makes navigation unmistakable without glow or ornamental effects.
keyCharacteristics: Title-first hierarchy with generous row spacing.
Chromatic dark surfaces rather than neutral charcoal.
Explicit publication-state text, reinforced by color.
Familiar controls with visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Words Before Color Rule
rules.body: Every publication state remains understandable without color.

dos: Do preserve dark-only surfaces, readable text, and the plum navigation field.
Do keep titles complete and publication states explicit.
Do use familiar controls and visible focus, hover, pressed, and disabled states.
donts: Don't substitute neon accents, glow, or analytics tiles for the content workspace.
Don't nest entry rows inside decorative cards.
Don't expose dead actions for features that are not implemented.
